title: Grouped Complete-Through-Cutoff Durable Inventory Evidence Resolution
selectedSlice: A — grouped durable resolution only via existing FOOD-006E exact primitives
purpose: Resolve one lossless FOOD-006K grouped complete-through-cutoff evidence set into durable exact production batch and physical movement snapshots without FOOD-006C limits or balance composition.
rules: Input is one FOOD-006K lossless grouped exact-SKU evidence value.
Exact SKU and cutoff are preserved.
Each exact production batch is read exactly once with readFoodProductionBatchByExactIdentity.
Each physical inventory movement is read exactly once with readFoodPhysicalInventoryMovementByExactIdentity.
No paginated FOOD-006D enumeration is used to emulate exact lookup.
FOOD-006E exact persistence primitives are reused directly without duplicating SQL.
Every batch durable read must return outcome found.
Every movement durable read must return outcome found.
not-found, invalid and storage-failure fail the whole grouped resolution.
No partial success value is returned after any durable read failure.
Resolved production batch exact identity must equal the FOOD-006K grouped batch identity.
Resolved production batch SKU must equal the FOOD-006K grouped exact SKU.
Resolved movement identity must equal the grouped movement identity.
Resolved movement batch identity must equal its FOOD-006K grouped batch identity.
Resolved movement SKU must equal the FOOD-006K grouped exact SKU.
productionBatchEvidenceSequence is preserved per batch.
movement evidenceSequence is preserved per movement.
FOOD-006K deterministic batch order is preserved.
FOOD-006K movement evidence-sequence order is preserved.
Empty grouping succeeds with zero durable reads.
One batch with zero movements performs exactly one durable read.
A batch with more than 128 movements is resolved without truncation.
More than 128 exact batches are resolved without truncation.
The result is detached and deeply frozen.
FOOD-006L does not construct or consume a FOOD-006C manifest.
FOOD-006L does not invoke FOOD-006F, FOOD-005Z or FOOD-006A balance composition.
FOOD-006L does not establish authoritative current quantity-on-hand.
FOOD-006L grants no capacity, availability, checkout, payment, fulfillment, accounting or rewards authority.
Migration 0005 remains definition-only and unexecuted.
deferred: Pure recorded-balance composition over the complete durable grouped evidence.
